topics.author: Jorge Doicela

replies.author: Jorge Doicela
replies.content: Para estado del servidor (caching, mutaciones), los Server Components + URL searchParams son lo más limpio. Para estado efímero del cliente (modales, toolbars interactivos), Zustand o React Context aislado por feature funciona de forma excelente sin penalizar el bundle.

replies.author: Alex Dev
replies.content: Excelente punto, separar el estado de servidor del de cliente reduce drásticamente los rerenders innecesarios.

replies.author: DevOps Engineer
replies.content: Configurar --max-old-space-size=300 en PM2 para el proceso backend y activar swap de 1GB en Debian previene caídas drásticas por picos de tráfico.

replies.author: Jorge Doicela
replies.content: For server state (caching, data mutations), Server Components paired with URL searchParams provide the cleanest solution. For transient client UI state (modals, interactive toolbars), Zustand or localized React Context per feature slice excels without bloating bundle weights.

replies.author: Alex Dev
replies.content: Spot-on analysis. Strictly segregating server state from client reactivity dramatically eliminates redundant rerenders.

replies.author: DevOps Engineer
replies.content: Configuring --max-old-space-size=300 in PM2 for the backend daemon alongside a 1 GB swapfile on Debian completely mitigates traffic burst OOM crashes.
